scope: Warnings at fixed 30% versus proton activity explicitly reported in subsequent NOAA SGAS. Bulletin labels, not continuous observed flux, ISS dose or proof of all-day quiet. Ambiguous days excluded.
baseline: Persist the last SGAS event/no-event state whose issue and retrospective Last-Modified precede 00:00 UTC cutoff.
forecast_method: Existing archived_weather selection with publication cutoff and archive SHA-256 validation; no fitting.

rows.evidence: S1 (Minor) solar radiation storms began at 10/1305 UTC and the S2 (Moderate) threshold was reached with a peak flux of 149 pfu at 10/1515 UTC.
10 Mev protons reached a peak flux of 116 pfu at 11/0910 UTC and the 100 MeV protons reached a peak flux of 7.78 pfu at 11/0715 UTC.
The greater than 10 MeV proton flux reached 10 pfu beginning at 08/0255 UTC, and reached a peak flux of 1,030 pfu at 08/0800 UTC.
The greater than 10 MeV proton flux exceeded 10 pfu through 09/2135 UTC.
The greater than 10 MeV proton event that began at 08/0255z, reached a maximum of 1,030 pfu at 08/0800z, ended at 09/2140z.
The greater than 10 MeV proton flux was elevated near 7 to 9 pfu, but has yet to cross the 10 pfu threshold.
